articleTitle: What to Ask a Parent With Dementia While They Can Still Talk
imageHeadline: Questions to Ask Your Parent With Dementia Now
imageSubtext: The full conversation guide is on the site
pinTitle: meaningful questions to ask parent with dementia before memory loss progresses
pinDescription: If your parent has dementia or primary progressive aphasia, certain questions can help you capture family stories and what matters most while they can still communicate. This guide walks through which conversations to prioritize and how to approach them with care. Get the full question list and conversation framework.
